description: Defines the logical_channel_config_list class for managing and querying a list of logical channel configurations within the ocudu namespace, including lookup mechanisms and validation checks.

classes.name: logical_channel_config_list
classes.description: Manages a list of logical channel configurations with lookup and validation features.

methods.name: logical_channel_config_list
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the list and performs validation and lookup table building.

methods.name: logical_channels
methods.description: Returns a span of logical channel configurations.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a given LCID or LCG-ID is present in the list.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Retrieves the logical channel configuration for a given LCID.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of logical channels.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Compares two logical_channel_config_list objects for equality.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Checks if two logical_channel_config_list objects are not equal.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Returns iterator to the beginning of the list.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Returns iterator to the end of the list.
